chunking: 7 file-group chunks (spec/app/core; data/demos/small-goldens+win+harness; qos; contention/emphasis/sla; surge-a; surge-b; warn) — canonical diff 15,003 lines

blockers.title: Active_Crisis.bundle is a compaction-prone slot index — a mid-crisis topology edit renumbers bundle slots, spuriously resolving / re-binding the crisis ([E13] dedup breach + root-cause mis-attribution)
blockers.evidence: core/bundles.odin — '// reset the bundle rows (a topology change can drop/reshape bundles; rebuild // from scratch ...)' clear(&b.bundle_lo) ... b.n = 0; then slots are assigned in pipe-slot order on first-seen canonical pair (bundles_slot_for_pair). core/types.odin:224 — 'bundle: u32, // Saturated_Bundle: the bottleneck bundle slot'. Resolve pass reads bundle_class_queue(state, cat, ac.bundle, ac.class) against the stale slot.
blockers.detail: Bundles are a derived view rebuilt from scratch per topology change. Demolish a full bundle whose slot precedes the crisis's named bundle mid-crisis: later slots shift down; the registry's slot ref now points at a different pair (or nothing). Resolve sees queue 0 + no bound lane -> spurious Crisis_Resolved while the real flaw is still saturated, then same-tick re-trigger (E13 chatter) or a silently vanishing crisis; banner/outline mislabel the bottleneck. The resolve test passes only because its fixture's canonical pairs preserve slot order.
blockers.recommended_fix: Key Active_Crisis on stable refs: the canonical (bundle_lo, bundle_hi) node pair or the E11-stable member pipe id, resolving the bundle slot at eval time (bundles_slot_for_pair / bundle_of_pipe).

blockers.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL — the settled-scan trigger branch never executes in any test, the 4.2 step tick-latch has zero coverage, and the 4.2 serialization surface has no byte-layout pins
blockers.evidence: Every fixture's saturated tick also sheds same-tick (drop scan wins), so crisis_find_saturated_bundle's ok=true branch never executes; no test steps a backward tick (replay_error=true unreachable); warnings_test's test_event_payload_byte_layout pins tags 1-7 only — no pin for the drop-payload target byte, tags 8/9, or the crises section.
blockers.detail: P0 100% (trigger exact-tick, dedup, catalog fail-fast, replay identity, terminal freeze pinned). P1 ~77%: the settled queue-at-bound half of the pinned trigger contract is unexecuted, the new critical-path latch is unexecuted, and deterministic-but-wrong serialization layouts would pass replay + blessed T1s silently. FAIL on P1 <80%.
blockers.recommended_fix: Add a settled-scan positive test (queue at bound, no same-tick drop), a backward-tick latch test, and byte-layout pins for the drop target + tags 8/9 payload + crises section; re-gate.

warnings.title: Pool_Exhaustion backstop is class-filtered — frozen contract says ANY Pool_Exhaustion drop
warnings.evidence: spec-4-2 (frozen): 'Pool_Exhaustion = the global pool at cap AND any `Pool_Exhaustion` drop this tick (map-wide flaw; no element ref).' Code: 'if len(state.flow.packets) >= int(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) && drop_of_class_this_tick(state, tick, sp.class, .Pool_Exhaustion, NO_BUNDLE)'.
warnings.detail: When QoS reprioritization makes a resident class pay the E22 shed while the surge rides a higher lane, the pool sits at cap shedding but no surge-class drop exists — the map-wide crisis never fires. Under-fires (fail-safe direction) but breaches the pinned 'any' definition.
warnings.recommended_fix: Drop the class filter for the backstop: require the pool at cap + any Pool_Exhaustion drop this tick, or amend the frozen contract text with the rationale.

warnings.title: surge.dem omits the frozen spec's mid-run capacity fix — no Crisis_Resolved pin in the launchable golden
warnings.evidence: Frozen Golden bullet: 'NEW demos/surge.dem (unprepared narrow-pipe fan: trigger @window start, a mid-run capacity fix, resolve after the window ends)'. Demo commands: only 'at 100ms draw 0 1 narrow' / 'at 100ms draw 1 2 narrow'; comment: 'the player never fixed it; the banner + red bottleneck outline persist'. 170s capture pins banner-present.
warnings.detail: The shipped demo never draws the fix, so the launchable increment never demonstrates the player-fix -> Crisis_Resolved arc and the golden never pins a resolved event end-to-end (unit tests cover resolve; E2E does not). The 'you can fix it' half of the fairness loop is undemonstrated.
warnings.recommended_fix: Author the fix into surge.dem per the frozen narrative (mid-run wide, demolish-first if ports are full), re-run to read the exact resolve tick, re-pin captures + comments.

warnings.title: Frozen 'pre-4.2 streams byte-identical' promise is false as written — the drop payload grew 4 bytes; only the change-log admits it
warnings.evidence: Frozen Events bullet: 'tag-conditional serialization, pre-4.2 streams byte-identical'. serialize.odin writes w_u32(&w, e.target) unconditionally for every Packet_Dropped; types.odin comment still claims 'pre-3.3/3.4/4.1/4.2 event streams stay byte-identical'; serialize.odin:358 still asserts 'existing T1 manifests must not shift'.
warnings.detail: All drop-bearing goldens shifted beyond the catalog fold (documented in the change-log — the mechanism is verified: state.catalog_hash rides every per-tick hash, and the drop payload adds 4 bytes). But the frozen contract text and both code comments still claim byte-identity — misleading for the next bless decision and any verifier reading the frozen block first.
warnings.recommended_fix: Amend the frozen Events bullet and both comments: drop payload grew 4 bytes (deliberate, cause-documented re-bless); byte-identity holds only for drop-free streams.

warnings.title: Trigger root-cause attribution reverses the pinned slot-order definition (drop's bundle first, not slot-order-first saturated bundle)
warnings.evidence: Frozen: 'Root cause = the first saturated bundle in slot order (a -> first hit; b -> first any-lane-at-bound fallback — a drop implies a bound lane).' Code evaluates crisis_drop_bundle_this_tick first and names the drop's bundle; the settled scan only runs when no drop occurred.
warnings.detail: On a tick with a surge-class drop while another bundle is also settled-saturated, the code names the drop's bundle, not the slot-order-first one the pinned definition selects. Change-log #1 documents the reversal (drop = admission-time evidence) but the frozen block is unamended; observable behavior differs from the pinned contract.
warnings.recommended_fix: Amend the frozen trigger block to the implemented drop-first attribution with the admission-evidence rationale, or restore slot-order selection.

warnings.title: Wrong-typed archetype_id silently loads as a pure demand event instead of failing fast
warnings.evidence: jstr returns '' for any non-string: 'if v, ok := o[key].(json.String); ok { return v } return ""'. Loader: 'sp.archetype_idx = -1; if aid := jstr(seo, "archetype_id"); aid != "" { ... }' — a numeric/bool/null value is indistinguishable from an absent field.
warnings.detail: 'archetype_id': 5 silently becomes 'no archetype' — the set-piece never fires a crisis with no load error, while an unknown string id fails fast. jint_strict was hardened for exactly this class; string fields got no strict accessor. ODN-5 fail-fast bar.
warnings.recommended_fix: Type-assert json.String explicitly: key present but not a string -> named load error; only a genuinely absent key means no archetype.

warnings.title: Crisis engine reads the ODN-14 event buffer as sim input, making the app's never-drain behavior a correctness contract
warnings.evidence: The app NEVER drains state.events (the 4.2 tripwire comment admits it); crisis_drop_bundle_this_tick / drop_of_class_this_tick scan the buffer tail-first relying on tick-ordering. The buffer grows unboundedly over a long session; any future drain/filter silently breaks crisis attribution.
warnings.detail: Sim logic now consumes the cross-layer event buffer whose documented contract is app-side draining after each step. A human-only tripwire comment guards a correctness invariant; unbounded buffer growth in long sessions is memory pressure on the app path.
warnings.recommended_fix: Record per-tick drop sites in a dedicated per-tick field on Flow_State (cleared each tick); crisis_evaluate reads that instead of scanning state.events.

warnings.title: test_crisis_replay_identity leaks the events array (2x256B) under the tracking allocator — the change-log's 'leak hygiene' claim misses it
warnings.evidence: odin test output: 'core.test_crisis_replay_identity +++ leak 256B @ ... crisis_test.odin:53:crisis_record_run()'. The closure does 'hashes, _ := crisis_record_run(&s, 2400, cat)' — every other crisis test defers delete(evs). project-context: 'leaks are CI failures'.
warnings.detail: Two 256B leaks per test run contradict change-log item 5 ('leak hygiene in crisis_record_run callers') and risk a CI tracking-allocator failure when the test runner tightens.
warnings.recommended_fix: Capture the events array in the replay closure and defer delete(evs) before returning hashes; give crisis_record_run an explicit allocator param (ODN-18).

notes.title: Step tick-latch rejects only backward ticks; equal ticks pass despite the 'strictly monotonic' claim
notes.detail: tick == state.tick re-runs the tick (double spawn/flow, duplicate events) without latching replay_error. No current caller does it; the guard is weaker than its comment.
notes.recommended_fix: Reject tick <= state.tick, or document non-decreasing semantics.

notes.title: E13 dedup key (archetype, set_piece) is coarser than arch §6.4's per-root-cause key
notes.detail: While a Saturated_Bundle crisis is active, the pool backstop for the same set-piece is suppressed. The frozen 4.2 spec pins the (archetype, set_piece) key, so the code is spec-compliant — but §6.4's 'per root cause' text now conflicts.
notes.recommended_fix: Align §6.4's wording with the frozen per-activation key (or key on kind too when more archetypes land).

notes.title: Set-piece index truncates to u16 in the dedup key and serialized row; demand.json has no set-piece count cap
notes.detail: >=65536 set-pieces in one era collides dedup keys and mislabels banner rows. Pathological data, but the crises roster got a 255 cap for exactly this truncation class.
notes.recommended_fix: Cap era set-piece count at load with a named error.

notes.title: Cooldown-blocked drop branch skips the settled-scan and pool backstop for that set-piece
notes.detail: On a cooldown block the loop continues past the alternative causes; a different-bundle saturation goes unnamed until the cooldown expires. Only reachable with cooldown > 0.
notes.recommended_fix: Fall through to the settled scan and pool backstop instead of continuing.
